about_the_game:
Marooned on the hostile alien expanse of Aethergald, your mission is no longer just discovery—it's survival. Face off against formidable creatures, navigate treacherous landscapes, and harness alien technology to fight your way back from the brink.

Features:

  • Intense Alien Encounters: Battle the island's creatures and monsters using a versatile arsenal of weapons, including the Static Staff, Energy Pistols, and much more as you traverse through the game.

  • Dynamic Exploration & Resource Management: Scour 5 diverse biomes in order to find ship pieces to escape the island once and for all. But be careful, these pieces are guarded by waves of enemies, so it's not going to be easy.

  • High-Stakes Traversal Skills: Use climbing ropes to get to parts you couldn't get to before, use jump pads to go even higher than normal, and more things you'll be seeing with the island's tech.

  • Unearth Powerful Lost Tech: Discover and repurpose forgotten alien technology to gain an edge against the dangers of Aethergald.

  • Use your Static Staff to defeat these foes: The only way to stop them and keep them away is by defeating them. Use your Static Staff and defeat them to make your way to the exit.

  • Shoot your Static Discharge: With the Static Staff, you'll be able to use the Static Discharge, where if you align it correctly, it shoots a wave of electricity towards enemies! That's one of the many abilities you'll find in weapons in this game.

The odds are stacked against you. Do you have what it takes to tame this savage world in The Explorer?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Steam OS and Ubuntu 12.04 are the only supported Linux OSes
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 1000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512MB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1600 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Minimum 10.7 to run the game
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 1000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512MB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1600 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 @2.3 GHz or AMD Dual-Core Athlon 2.4 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 9.0c compliant

short_description: Play as Ellie, an outer space adventurer stranded on the hostile alien world of Aethergald. Fight deadly creatures, uncover lost alien tech, and explore treacherous biomes to escape—if you can.
